# IDEA: This course should be quicker-paced, due to spohomores having more prior coding experience than freshmen.

## Visualization 1: Bar Chart
<img src="C:\Users\John\Desktop\personal-site.github.io\static\imgs\Screenshot 2026-04-27 154000.png" alt="Unstandardized Bar Chart "  width="500"/>
This chart shows the prior experience levels by group> However, there is an issue. There are 165 freshmen and only 36 sophomores, and the chart does not account for that. We will need a better visualization to really understand our data.

## Visualization 2: Proportional Bar Chart
<img src="C:\Users\John\Desktop\personal-site.github.io\static\imgs\Screenshot 2026-04-27 154059.png" alt="Bar Chart Standardized for Population Size "  width="500"/>
In this chart, I chose to display the PROPORTION of each group that reports each prior experience level. This way, the huge difference in population sizes between the two groups does not skew the data like it did in Visualization 1.

## Visualization 3: Heatmap
<img src="C:\Users\John\Desktop\personal-site.github.io\static\imgs\Screenshot 2026-04-27 154126.png" alt="Heat Map of Prior Experience Levels by Class Year"  width="500"/>
This visualization is something that I made purely for convenience purposes. It is a lot easier to look at a heatmap and understand what it represents at a glance than a bar chart or scatterplot. This way, someone less familiar with the rest of the analysis can still see what our data looks like.
